scope: N04 finite artificial dependency-pump comparison, not an adopted executor or blocking wrapper
nested_scope: distinct system handlers only; active handler and nested user never reentered
operation: one synchronous dependency attempt retains caller frames; depth limit or unavailable producer returns a distinct outcome; no unbounded retry loop
continuation: one callback tries dependency state and returns Pending; explicit rounds eventually retry
cycles: same active actor is rejected; depth limit may stop before a longer cycle is reached
ownership: caller holds persist during nested attempt and release on unwind; opaque or foreign ownership is preserved
external: IRQ or remote completion is an explicit stimulus, never a normal callback or implied successful producer
